Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1239
Claimant:
Ryan Roberts
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
June 27, 2024
Reported rear-end collision received and assigned for review. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further
contact will go through the attorney's office.
August 19, 2024
Vehicle inspection scheduled. The damage to the rear of the claimant's vehicle appears consistent with the impact
described in the first report.
August 20, 2024
Police report obtained. It confirms the claimant was present in the vehicle at the time of the collision and lists the other
driver's account.
August 28, 2024
Photographs taken at the scene were reviewed. They confirm some details of the damage and positioning, but no
independent witnesses have come forward.
September 27, 2024
Claimant's counsel submitted a medical summary describing neck and back strain. The reported injury is plausible for
a collision of this type and speed.
October 12, 2024
Recorded statement taken from the claimant. The account matches the one given at first notice and in the follow-up
call with the adjuster.
October 13, 2024
Records check completed. No prior injury to the same body area is known, and no earlier damage to the vehicle
appears in our file.
October 20, 2024
Repair estimate from before the policy start was located in the file. It lists damage to the same rear panels, which
conflicts with the claimant's account that the vehicle was undamaged beforehand.
November 18, 2024
Referred the repair estimate discrepancy to the supervisor for review. Requested an explanation from counsel and
the original repair facility.
November 26, 2024
Treatment records received. Care followed a typical course, with physical therapy and medication, and symptoms
eased steadily as the claimant improved.
December 19, 2024
Verified the insured driver is named on the policy and the policy was in force at the time of loss. Coverage confirmed
for the reported incident.
January 23, 2025
File reviewed with the supervisor. The injury claim remains open pending counsel's rseponse on the prior repair
estimate and a final review of the treatment billing.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
